summary: The RptMnuStudentPreferencesList user control provides a configurable UI and workflow for generating and exporting a list report of student preferences. The report filters by Department, Program, and Cohort, and the output is rendered in CSV format for display and download.
purpose: To allow users to query, filter, and export a list of student preferences using configurable dropdowns for Department, Program, and Cohort, and to present the results via the UI in a downloadable CSV format.

fields.name: lblReportHTML
fields.description: Displays the report results as HTML

workflows.name: Generate Student Preferences List Report
steps: User loads the control; if UserSession is present, descriptions and options are displayed, and dropdowns are populated.
User selects a Department: ddDepartment is populated, possibly based on user permissions.
User selects a Program: ddProgram is filtered by the selected Department.
User selects a Cohort: ddCohort is filtered by the selected Program; selection of ALL is possible.
User clicks Run Report (cmdRunReport); only enabled if a Program is available.
System invokes the stored procedure ReportStudentPreferencesListCSV with parameters: SessionID, ProgramID, CohortID.
System fetches relevant data, invokes ReportMain.OutputCSV to generate CSV output.
If output is available, it is set in lblReportHTML and displayed in pnlReportHTML.

business_rules: Department, Program, and Cohort dropdowns require valid selections; list contents depend on session permissions.
The Run Report button is only visible/enabled when there are Programs loaded for the selected Department.
Selecting a new Department refreshes Programs and Cohorts.
Selecting a new Program refreshes Cohorts.
If no Cohort is selected, 'ALL' may be specified (represented by 0).
validations: Dropdown values for Department, Program, and Cohort must be valid.
If a required field (like Program) is not selected, report generation is not enabled.
ValidationSummary1 is present for summarizing validation errors.
calculations: Cohort dropdown will always insert an 'ALL' option as the first selectable value for broader queries.
conditions: cmdRunReport button is only available if ddProgram has items.
Dropdown lists are re-populated when relevant parent selections change.
system_behavior: Page_PreRender checks user session and populates dropdowns and descriptive fields.
On Department or Program change, lower-level dropdowns cascade refresh.
Report generation is a server-side event triggered by cmdRunReport_Click.
Report output is displayed only if there is non-empty data.
dependencies: Requires UserSession for permissions and data access.
Depends on DataLayer objects: Departments, Programs, Cohorts.
Requires SessionID, ProgramID, CohortID parameters for database procedure.
exceptions: If UserSession is null or invalid, dropdowns and descriptions are not populated.
If data queries return no results, no report is displayed.
content_gaps: The actual CSV output format and detailed data fields are not shown.
Error handling on data access or procedure execution is not fully described.
User interface layout and visual arrangement are not provided.
